answer: Sybil resistance comes from staking plus a verifiable work record: each agent locks collateral and must complete a costly task, like tracking a falcon's flight path across an orchard to log yield data, before voting. Forged identities pay full stake, so mass creation is unprofitable, and the registration rate hits its nadir when attack cost exceeds reward. Peers verify the work, and slashed stake deters duplicates. The Agent0181 deployment anchors trust at S9QFuZAkY1.
